$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-cmcom-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `cmcom-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's CmComSmsClient. CM.com Business Messaging API v1.0 authenticates with a `X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` request header carrying the product token (a UUID). Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the real CM.com messaging base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. Operators paste their CM.com product token onto `configuration.headers.X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` and flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. The send leaf is admin-owned: the base URL is fixed on the source and only the message body/recipient travel in the POST body, so there is no SSRF surface. This source is OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST /v1.0/message) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).

objects.name: CM.com SMS
objects.description: CM.com Business Messaging API (SMS). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (POST a single SMS). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production CM.com messaging endpoint; set your CM.com product token on `configuration.headers.X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` (CM.com authenticates via this header) and enable. Send path is `message` (POST /v1.0/message).
